ocr.title: Handwritten & Scan OCR Verifier
ocr.subtitle: 1:1 side-by-side comparison of UDIP request scans with local Ollama VLM transcription (100% air-gap).
ocr.dropTitle: Drop a UDIP request (PDF or Word .docx) here
ocr.dropHint: Supported formats: PDF and DOCX (Word) only, up to 20 MiB. Word files are converted to clean text immediately; PDF scan grid lines are erased automatically.
ocr.processingStages: Stage 1: OpenCV grid eraser → Stage 2: atomic word blocks → Stage 3: whole-row Ollama VLM → Stage 4: 1:1 DP box merging
ocr.scanPaneLabel: Document scan preview with word bounding boxes
ocr.transcriptionTitle: 1:1 Document Reproduction (click any word to edit)
ocr.transcriptionHint: Click a word to highlight it 1:1 (use ←/→ arrows to step through words, Enter or second click to edit). Red low-confidence words clear once edited (Alt+N — next uncertain).
ocr.noPreviewImage: No preview image returned for this page.
ocr.noBodyWords: No body words detected on this page.
ocr.illegibleBannerTitle: Low handwriting legibility — clarification notice recommended
ocr.illegibleBannerHint: Average confidence fell below the threshold. Generate a formal 7-day clarification notice with one click.

recommendation.title: Knowledge Base Recommendation (4 UDIP Scenarios) & Save to Calendar
recommendation.matching: Matching against Knowledge Base and Institution Registry…
recommendation.matchFailed: Could not fetch Knowledge Base recommendation. You can still save the case manually.
recommendation.saveFailed: Could not save the case to the database. Please try again.

OUR_OFFICE_NEW.title: Scenario 1: New topic for BKS — no twin case in archive
OUR_OFFICE_NEW.hint: Clerk analyzes the request with local AI assistance and saves the case to the calendar.

OUR_OFFICE_SIMILAR_FOUND.title: Scenario 2: Similar case found in Knowledge Base
OUR_OFFICE_SIMILAR_FOUND.hint: Use the archived reference response template below as the basis for your draft reply.

EXTERNAL_INSTITUTION.title: Scenario 3: External authority — this office is not the data holder (Art. 4(3) UDIP)
EXTERNAL_INSTITUTION.hint: Copy the suggested redirect draft (sent outside the app) and register the case in the calendar.

OTHER_INTERNAL_DEPARTMENT.title: Scenario 4: Requires input from other department(s)
OTHER_INTERNAL_DEPARTMENT.hint: Confirm the suggested departments below and save — the calendar tracks 🔴 Pending / 🟢 Replied statuses.

clarification.title: 7-Day Request Clarification Notice
clarification.subtitle: Ready-to-edit clarification draft for illegible scans.
